what: A model (Claude Haiku 4.5) reads a drawing search query and proposes the kind, dimension intervals, material and exclusions; a proposal is kept only when its quote is in the query, and it replaces the pattern reading only where its quote contains the pattern's span (retrieval/understanding.py). Templates: ten workshop phrasings per family built from the generator's gold (range, cm, 이상, number without unit, English, particle, plain control, material exclusion, unit spelled out, no spaces), dev split first, test split once, nothing changed between them. Free-form: thirty hand-written queries outside the templates, ten of them with numbers that are not conditions, run once. Scored field by field in millimetres against the expected conditions for the pattern reading and the model-merged reading; then the same queries through the hybrid search (exact + BM25 + E5) ordered by each reading's conditions, scored against the drawings whose gold satisfies the query. Batches whose ordering names the kind use the stated part kind to widen the RRF top-20 pool and as one more condition; replay batches re-measure the stored model readings through that ordering without a call. Harness fitwitness.evaluation.query_understanding, workflow query-understanding-evaluation.

repeats.what: the test split three times with the model (test, test-repeat-2, test-repeat-3)

kind_ordering.what: the stated part kind widens the RRF top-20 pool with candidates of that kind and counts as one condition; measured by replaying the stored readings (no call)

freeform.what: thirty hand-written queries outside the templates, ten of them with numbers that are not conditions, run once

misses.FREE-10: excluded material written as 'stainless steel', not SUS304 (meaning right, code wrong)
misses.FREE-20: hole_spacing 40 read as an open interval alongside the correct upper bound on thickness
